decision_basis: Jon's written directive of 2026-07-12 to execute the Garnet S114 Plan of Attack (Garnet-S114-Plan-of-Attack-v1-2026-07-12) end to end. Phase 0 of that plan directs recording a Jon-authored/approved S114 acceptance artifact scoped to first-party CLI/Wasm trust-kernel behavior. This file is the recorded decision; the launch reporter reads it and does not grade it.
independence_note: This acceptance is a governance decision, not an independence relabel. The S114 verdict language in C_Language_Specification/GARNET_RED_TEAM.md, CURRENT_STATE.md, CHANGELOG.md, and docs/why.html is unchanged: S114 remains 'independently-re-verified-with-fixes'. Only Jon may relabel independence; this artifact does not do so.

conditions.text: Scope S114 to first-party CLI/Wasm trust-kernel behavior. Acceptance does not imply every embedding mode, platform, or library pathway is sealed.
conditions.closure: This artifact plus the launch-ledger accepted-scoped row.

conditions.text: Restore or rerun the independent proof bundle into durable history so the strongest evidence no longer lives only in unreachable Git objects.
conditions.closure: Mission phase P1: land the Codex verdict bundle (commit 61cfbae) and the Windows lane-2 review bundle (commit 6153726) under tracked proofs/ with manifest hashes enforced by scripts/garnet_evidence_integrity_status.py.

conditions.text: Preserve the PR #471 /why wording; do not expand public claims because of S114. /why keeps exactly its two bounded enforced claims.
conditions.closure: Mission phase P2: a claim fixture asserts the two bounded claims remain and forbidden universal-enforcement phrasing stays out of the public surfaces.

conditions.text: Do not claim universal runtime enforcement for all @caps. Public language must distinguish declared, checker-rejected, runtime-gated, and OS-sandboxed authority.
conditions.closure: Mission phase P2: C_Language_Specification/GARNET_CAPABILITY_ENFORCEMENT_SCOPE.md plus reporter/README/docs copy corrections.

conditions.text: Track embedder strict mode, dependency-preload fail-soft, and test-helper fail-soft as hardening work, not as reasons to reject the whole S114 result.
conditions.closure: Mission phase P3: embedder strict-by-default with explicit permissive opt-out, dependency-preload fail-closed, and test-helper fail-closed, each with regression tests.

out_of_scope: Third-party embedders of garnet-interp / garnet-vm: permissive (unframed) execution is still possible unless strict/framed is chosen; being hardened in mission phase P3 (embedder strict-by-default). Not covered by this acceptance.

Capability rows that are checker-only (time::*, uuid v4/v7) or declared-only (ffi, net_internal): enforced at check time / in generated sandbox policy, NOT uniformly runtime-gated. Documented in the P2 capability enforcement scope table.
OS-level sandbox enforcement: seccomp/WASI/egress policy is generated (enforced:false) and applied only on Linux via an external reference harness; macOS/Windows OS sandboxing is named-deferred.
memory::* natives: bridge-only, caps-invisible; outside the capability registry.
tracked_debt: garnet-cli REPL helper preload (src/repl.rs) shares the same warn-and-continue pattern as the test-helper lane; P3 hardens the test lane, the REPL lane remains a follow-up.
The two enforcement-status scripts are string-presence checks, not behavioral proofs; behavioral evidence is the cargo test suites.
why.html claim language has no automated linter until the P2 claim fixture lands; the semantic caps-claims-as-doctests guard remains queued.
notes: launch_ready remains False and the recommendation remains HOLD after this acceptance: the static playground, live WASM playground, and minimum sealed shelf gates are still open. This acceptance closes only the S114 governance row; it makes no runtime-safety or launch-readiness claim.
